name: Camp Somerset for Girls
description_short: Overnight camp for girls on 50 acres along East Pond in Smithfield, in the Belgrade Lakes region. Girls who have finished grades 3 to 9 live in cabins by age, with a large waterfront for sailing, waterskiing and paddling and a gym for gymnastics, in a seven week or three and a half week session.
swim_waterfront_notes: 2,000 feet of waterfront on East Pond with swimming, sailing, kayaking, canoeing, fishing and a waterski and wakeboard program.
notes: Full Somer $17,900 (deposit $3,500); Half Somer $10,800 (deposit $2,500). Discounts for sisters, Camp Manitou siblings, referrals and alumni families. Brother camp is Camp Manitou; the same team runs Camp Eastwood for younger campers.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2027 Dates & Rates page: Full Somer June 24 to August 10 $17,900; Half Somer June 24 to July 16 or July 19 to August 10 $10,800; deposits and discounts.

Researched by Claude from this page. Location & Facilities page: 11 Somerset Lane, Smithfield, ME 04978, 50 acres on East Pond, waterfront and gymnastics facilities, three family style meals a day. Grades from the Age Groups & Cabins page (completed 3rd grade to completed 9th grade).

warnings: Not the same camp as Camp Matoaka (also girls, East Pond, Smithfield, already published): different address (One Great Place) and website.
